machines.name: M42
machines.blurb: Where it started — an ultralight, printable telescope. Sardonic by default, optically sound by design.

machines.name: Elli
machines.tagline: A refined Dobsonian for people who learned from the first one.
machines.blurb: 130mm of light-gathering, an improved truss, and a focuser that earns the word precision. Same existential dread, better everything.

machines.name: jigawatt
machines.tagline: A small machine that disagrees with lightning.
machines.blurb: Listens for lightning and opens the mains contactor before the thunder finishes its sentence. Unit 001, made on purpose, living in a wall.

machines.name: lokki
machines.tagline: Coordinated light for places that try to be quiet.
machines.blurb: A coordinator and up to eight leaves that agree on light over LoRa — no cloud, no broker, no recurring fee. For venues that would rather not be seen switching anything on.

machines.name: Clear Skies
machines.tagline: A monthly guide to what's up there.
machines.blurb: An offline night-sky almanac for a small telescope at ~32°N. A new edition each month; works with no signal, which is rather the point.

machines.name: Sirious
machines.blurb: Point it at the sky and it tells you what you're looking at — or where to find what you came for. Still on the bench.
